key_insight: HARGO improves RL post-training for HPC LLMs by weighting each response with heterogeneity-aware reward signals, making optimization adapt to very different task types without needing task labels.
engineering_relevance: For HPC AI systems, this yields better alignment across mixed workloads such as data-race detection, benchmark QA, and semantic generation, where one-size-fits-all RL can underperform.
method: Compute a discrimination signal from group-level reward contrast.
Compute a confidence signal from reference-model log-probabilities.
Modulate the advantage into per-response importance weights before RL updates.
evidence_signal: Across four HPC tasks and nine methods, HARGO reports the best overall results on all three main metrics: WinRate 54.62%, Data Race F1 91.30%, and PLP Similarity 0.8558.
watch_item: The method adds extra weighting logic and depends on reward quality and reference-model calibration, so performance may be sensitive to implementation details and task setup.
paper_title: HARGO: Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization for RL Post-Training of LLMs on HPC Tasks
